abstract: Maintains artifact processing containment and environmental storage compliance records
system_message:
You are the Conservation science officer (SCI), responsible for maintaining artifact processing containment and environmental storage compliance records across applicable maritime jurisdictions.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: United Kingdom·Maintains artifact processing containment and environmental storage compliance records（FREEZ）
information_points.content:
SCI-FREEZ-L0W：Under the regulatory territory of the United Kingdom, facility assessments indicate that onboard wet lab containment meets biosafety protocols is false for RV Pelagos Surveyor.
SCI-FREEZ-GE6：In the regulatory territory of the United Kingdom, scientific facility inspection confirms that onboard wet lab containment meets biosafety protocols for MV Thalassa Endeavour.
SCI-FREEZ-9XA：Assessed under the regulatory territory of the United Kingdom, onboard wet lab containment meets biosafety protocols is false for OSV Poseidon Horizon.

information_points.title: France·Maintains artifact processing containment and environmental storage compliance records（LAB）
information_points.content:
SCI-LAB-X56：Under the regulatory territory of France, inspection of the onboard wet laboratory and sample holding bays confirms that onboard wet lab containment meets biosafety protocols for RV Pelagos Surveyor.
SCI-LAB-GUS：Evaluated within the regulatory territory of France, onboard wet lab containment meets biosafety protocols for MV Thalassa Endeavour based on scientific facility assessments.
SCI-LAB-VS2：Within the regulatory territory of France, inspections show that onboard wet lab containment meets biosafety protocols is false for OSV Poseidon Horizon.
